transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been feeling extremely shaken up, anxious, and jumpy for the past three days. Ever since a scary event occurred, I just can't seem to calm down or feel safe.
I am sorry to hear you are going through this. Could you tell me exactly how many days have passed since the event occurred?
It happened exactly three days ago. Honestly, it feels like it just happened this morning because I still can't shake this constant feeling of dread.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports that the distressing event occurred only three days ago. Per the DSM-5-TR, Acute Stress Disorder is the appropriate diagnosis when symptoms occur for three days to one month following exposure to a traumatic event. Posttraumatic Stress Disorder is excluded at this time because it requires symptoms to persist for more than one month.
